Ensure JSON binding via Echo's `c.Bind()` correctly populates these fields from the request body
Do NOT log the struct before zeroing credential fields (see audit log safety requirement)

subtasks.title: Implement API validation rules in POST /workspaces handler
details: After binding the request, validate mutual exclusion: if `git_pat` is non-nil and either `git_username` or `git_password` is non-nil, return HTTP 400
Validate pair completeness: if exactly one of `git_username`/`git_password` is non-nil, return HTTP 400
Validate HTTPS requirement: if any credential field is non-nil and `git_url` does not start with `https://`, return HTTP 400 with message `git credentials require an HTTPS git_url`
Zero out credential fields on the request struct before any logging occurs (audit log safety)

subtasks.title: Implement credential validation call and sanitised error response
details: After API validation passes and credentials are present, construct the appropriate `transport.AuthMethod`: PAT → `&http.BasicAuth{Username: "x-token-auth", Password: *req.GitPAT}`; username/password → `&http.BasicAuth{Username: *req.GitUsername, Password: *req.GitPassword}`
Call `ValidateCredentialsFuncType(ctx, req.GitURL, authMethod)`

On any error (including `context.DeadlineExceeded`), log the raw go-git error at ERROR level server-side, then return HTTP 400 with body `{"error": "credential validation failed for <git_url>: unable to authenticate"}`
If no credentials are provided, skip the validation call entirely

task_groups.title: Implement atomic credential storage with compensating DELETE

subtasks.title: Store credentials as workspace-scoped secrets after validation
details: After credential validation passes, create the workspace row in the database

Call `store.CreateSecrets("workspace", slug, entries)` where entries map: PAT → `[{Key: "GIT_PAT", Value: *req.GitPAT}]`; username/password → `[{Key: "GIT_USERNAME", Value: *req.GitUsername}, {Key: "GIT_PASSWORD", Value: *req.GitPassword}]`
If no credentials are provided, skip the `CreateSecrets` call

subtasks.title: Implement compensating DELETE on CreateSecrets failure
details: If `CreateSecrets` returns an error after the workspace row has been inserted, issue a compensating `DELETE` on the workspace row using the workspace slug
If the compensating DELETE succeeds, return HTTP 500 to the client

If the compensating DELETE also fails, emit a CRITICAL-level structured log entry including the workspace slug (e.g. `logger.Critical("compensating DELETE failed", "slug", slug, "error", err)`), then return HTTP 500 to the client
Do NOT implement retry logic or a reconciliation job — the CRITICAL log is the operator signal

subtasks.title: Enqueue clone job after successful secret storage
details: Only after both workspace INSERT and `CreateSecrets` succeed, enqueue the clone job
Return HTTP 201 with the workspace response body
Ensure the clone job enqueue step is not reached if either the INSERT or `CreateSecrets` fails

subtasks.title: Extend CloneFuncType signature with auth parameter
details: Update `CloneFuncType` in `internal/workspace/` to add `auth transport.AuthMethod` as the last parameter before return values
New signature: `type CloneFuncType func(ctx context.Context, path string, url string, depth int, singleBranch bool, refName string, auth transport.AuthMethod) (headSHA string, err error)`
Update `defaultCloneFn` to pass `auth` to `git.CloneOptions.Auth`; when `auth` is nil, behaviour is unchanged (public repo)
Update all existing call sites of `CloneFuncType` to pass `nil` as the auth argument (preserving existing public-repo behaviour)

subtasks.title: Implement credential lookup in clone worker
details: Before performing a clone, call `secretsStore.GetSecretValue("workspace", slug, "GIT_PAT")`
If PAT found, construct `&http.BasicAuth{Username: "x-token-auth", Password: pat}` and pass to `CloneFuncType`
If PAT not found, call `GetSecretValue` for `GIT_USERNAME` and `GIT_PASSWORD`; if both found, construct `&http.BasicAuth{Username: username, Password: password}`
If neither credential set is found, pass `nil` as auth to `CloneFuncType`
Handle `NotFoundError` from `GetSecretValue` as the expected no-credentials case (not an error)

subtasks.title: Apply same credential lookup to reclone on reactivation
details: Locate the reclone path triggered by workspace reactivation in the clone worker or reactivation handler
Apply the same credential lookup logic (GIT_PAT → GIT_USERNAME/GIT_PASSWORD → nil) before calling `CloneFuncType`
Verify that credentials persisted in the secrets table across archive/reactivate cycles are correctly retrieved
